# Security policy

## Report a vulnerability

Report it privately at https://github.com/pqoqubbw/zriz/security/advisories/new. Please do not open a public issue, discussion or pull request about it.

Tell me the package and version, what an attacker can do, and the smallest code or steps that show it. A crafted image or SVG that runs script, reads pixels across origins, or freezes the page is the kind of thing I want to hear about.

I maintain zriz alone. I reply within 7 days. Once a fix is released, I publish a GitHub security advisory and credit you, unless you would rather stay anonymous.

## Supported versions

`@zriz/core` and `@zriz/react` always release together under one version number. Fixes land in the next release only, so upgrade to get them.

| Version        | Supported |
| -------------- | --------- |
| Latest release | Yes       |
| Older releases | No        |

## Scope

This covers the two npm packages, the docs site at zriz.dev, and the GitHub Actions workflows in this repository.
